company_research.summary: Oncoustics is a Toronto-based medical technology startup with 25 employees that uses AI to transform ultrasound data into diagnostic tools for liver and prostate disease. The company has raised over $11M in total funding, including a 2022 seed round and multiple non-dilutive grants in 2024 and 2025 to support FDA regulatory submissions. As a QA/Test Co-op, you would be working in a hybrid startup environment focused on high-stakes medical software (SaMD) where rigorous testing is critical for clinical trials and regulatory clearance.
